prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, hip-up portrait, vertical portrait-orientation. One woman centred in the frame, face clearly visible, framed from the very top of her head down to the upper thighs so the full hips are in frame, the frame cutting off there. Mid 20s.

A Taiwanese woman, mid 20s, with an extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest — and below it, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projecting forward from her long, powerful torso, its surface taut and round, with a slight inward taper still visible at her waist on either side of the belly. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, and a sweet cafe-girl heroine look brought to life, with glossy dark-brown hair, in two low pigtails tied with big white lace ribbons and soft see-through bangs, each strand real hair with natural shine, fine flyaways and a few loose wisps. Her eyes are huge, perfectly round eyes with an enormous visible iris in warm rose-brown contact lenses with a darker limbal ring and a round natural pupil, one large bright catchlight and one small catchlight in each iris, a thick drawn lower lash line, long curled lashes, a soft pink shimmer on the lids and a tiny gem at the inner corners, under thin, high, simple brows, with real wet eyes and real eyelid skin around them, the eyes taking up about half the width of her face in exaggerated anime proportion, with the iris filling most of the eye opening, set slightly wider apart than normal, with a crisp dark double-eyelid line and a faint luminous ring of light in each iris. Her lips are small and glossy, in a strawberry-red gradient, deeper in the centre and fading at the edges, curved into a sweet smile. A deep pink blush spreads in soft round patches over both cheeks and across the tip of the nose. A tiny nose reduced to a small soft rounded dot with a faint shade beneath it, the bridge and nostrils almost invisible, a very small simple mouth with the corners lifted slightly, a small pointed chin, and a narrow, delicately pointed anime face shape. A sweet, welcoming, wide-eyed gaze with the head tilted slightly. She is wearing a cosplay costume: a tight white sailor-collar crop top with a centre front zipper, a pink ribbon tie and lace trim, midriff bare, and a matching ultra micro bikini bottom in the same fabric and colour worn low on her hips beneath the lower curve of her belly, her pregnant belly fully bare above it, her shoulders and arms bare. Jewelry: on each ear, four separate heavy ear weights of real blackened cast iron hanging from a polished silver ring through the lobe, each on its own silver chain of a different length so they hang staggered at different heights and fully visible side by side: on the left ear a teardrop-shaped sinker, a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim, a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a pyramid-shaped lump; on the right ear a ship's anchor, a cube-shaped block, a miniature anvil, a barrel-shaped weight. Every weight is a dense, solid, rough, matte, hammered lump of black cast iron about the size of a large walnut, hanging freely in the air with the longest weight ending at the level of her collarbones, and their weight gently pulls each earlobe down into a soft, slightly elongated, healthy loop of smooth skin. At her neck she wears a real chunky sterling silver cable-chain necklace resting on her collarbones.

Background: a softly blurred cozy cafe with pastel decor and warm lights.

Her skin, across her face, neck, shoulders, chest, arms and belly, is real human skin with visible fine pores across the nose and cheeks, a few tiny freckles and small beauty marks on her face, shoulders, chest, arms and belly, a faint uneven warmth with a pink flush on the cheeks and the tip of the nose, a soft shadow under the eyes, fine natural lines at the corners of the eyes and lips, a light natural sheen on the nose, forehead, collarbones and chest, and the rest of her skin in a soft natural matte finish, real living flesh with warmth. She is a professional cosplayer in a flawless cosplay transformation: large circle lenses, thick false lashes with drawn lower lashes, eyelid tape for a wide double lid, contouring that shrinks the nose and sharpens the chin, and a high-quality wig with a natural hairline and real-looking strands. Her pregnant belly is the visible centerpiece of her frame.
Lighting: bright, soft, even light across her face with only gentle shading. Shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. 8K vertical portrait-orientation 3:4 aspect ratio.
